display.purpose: Headings; self-hosted licensed font files from the Ark source.

body.purpose: Body copy and controls, with a sans-serif fallback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduce transitions and disable smooth scrolling when requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square wine button used for primary actions; hover clears the fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-button" type="button">Get a free site review</button>
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .75rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--business-accent, #111111); border-radius: 0; background: var(--business-accent, #111111); color: #fff; font: 600 .9rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--business-fg, #111111); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent, #111111); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, transparent field with a mixed-foreground border and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: var(--business-fg, #111111); font: 600 .9rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--business-fg, #111111), transparent 55%); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--business-fg, #111111); font: 400 1rem/1.65 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent, #111111); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--business-muted, #555555); }

components.name: Current Navigation Link
components.description: Text navigation with an accent underline for the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav a { color: var(--business-fg, #111111); font: 400 .88rem/1.65 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--business-accent, #111111); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { text-decoration-color: var(--business-accent, #111111); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .45rem; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent, #111111); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Clear service information and direct contact
narrative.overview: ARK Web Services uses a restrained black, white, and gray visual system. Headings use its self-hosted Montserrat Alternates font, while open space, readable copy, and fine rules organize the service pages. Client proof appears only when it is present in the source and approved. Contact uses a truthful email and phone fallback until inquiry delivery is configured.
keyCharacteristics: Soft white surfaces with near-black text and readable gray support copy.
Self-hosted Montserrat Alternates headings with DM Sans body text.
Open space, thin rules, and direct service links.
Responsive layouts and visible keyboard focus.
dos: Do keep values tied to business.config.ts.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use direct email and phone contact while inquiry delivery is disabled.
Do use approved client quotes and supplied Ark assets only.
donts: Do not invent client proof, ratings, prices, credentials, or portfolio photography.
Do not promise rankings, traffic, leads, or delivery timelines without approved evidence.
Do not send names, email addresses, or message contents to analytics.
Do not enable inquiry success states until storage and message delivery are working.
